create_flexolmo_config: create a FlexOlmoConfig with custom vocab size, hidden size, and number of experts for MoE architecture
build_flexolmo_model: build a FlexOlmoModel from a FlexOlmoConfig for dense and sparse MoE transformer inference
run_flexolmo_causal_lm: run FlexOlmoForCausalLM for autoregressive token generation with MoE routing and past key value caching
configure_flexolmo_decoder: configure a FlexOlmoDecoderLayer with post-attention and post-feedforward layer norm for residual connections
setup_flexolmo_moe_routing: setup FlexOlmoSparseMoeBlock with FlexOlmoTopKRouter for top-k expert selection during forward pass
